objective: Parameterize the chemically changed TT-CPD core and validate each glycosidic boundary with the smallest model that retains the complete covalent photoproduct, while transferring unchanged sugar-phosphate chemistry from CHARMM36.

literature_basis.practice: Develop new CHARMM terms on small model compounds, use MP2/6-31G(d) geometries and vibrations, add diffuse functions for anions, and validate assembled molecules separately.
Transfer established ribose and phosphate terms, fit new base chemistry with capped fragments, and validate the assembled modified nucleotide and oligonucleotide in condensed-phase MD.
Fit strained four-membered-ring bonded terms on small training compounds and test transfer on separate validation compounds.
Use an isolated N-methyl cis-syn thymine dimer for lesion electrostatics rather than treating the complete DNA environment quantum mechanically.
Keep the reactive two-base chromophore in the QM region and represent the surrounding oligonucleotide and solvent with MM.

retains: both product crosslinks in the reviewed ordered graph (like-numbered for syn and crossed C5/C6 for anti)
determines: ring proper and stereochemical improper response

single_endpoint_glycosidic_boundary.model: complete two-base TT-CPD with one full deoxyribose and one N1 methyl cap
variants: retain endpoint 1 deoxyribose; hydroxyl-cap its open O3'
retain endpoint 2 deoxyribose; hydroxyl-cap its open O5'
retains: the opposite endpoint's neutral N1 methyl cap
determines: lesion-to-sugar coupling for each ordered endpoint

phosphate_and_remote_backbone.action: transfer unchanged CHARMM36 nucleic-acid atom types, charges, and bonded parameters
phosphate_and_remote_backbone.reason: The TT photocycloaddition changes the two base C5/C6 environments but neither creates nor removes a sugar-phosphate bond. Mixed lesion terms end at the glycosidic interface covered by the endpoint fragments.
phosphate_and_remote_backbone.validation: Audit the assembled d(TpT) patch and short DNA in MM/NAMD; escalate to a full d(TpT) QM target only if a named boundary-transfer metric fails.

representative_plan.all_eight_identity_rule: Every ordered product keeps an independent atom map and signed-chirality audit. A shared fitted block may be released only after its held-out checks pass.

qm_protocol.torsions: relaxed constrained MP2/6-31G(d) scans only for acyclic glycosidic central bonds

full_boundary_policy.currently_submitted_alpine_jobs: leave submitted and accept results as independent validation evidence if they run
escalation_triggers: endpoint-fragment MM/QM geometry or response target fails
a mixed lesion/glycosidic parameter is not identifiable from the fragment targets
assembled d(TpT) minimization leaves large projected forces at either glycosidic boundary
short explicit-solvent DNA loses product stereochemistry or develops reproducible local instability

release_effect: Prepared or completed fragment calculations are evidence only. They do not release a force field or open any NAMD capability gate.
